mapper.select:
select ss.ID,ss.PARK_ID,ss.COMPANY_NAME,ss.BEGIN_EFFECT_TIME,ss.END_EFFECT_TIME,ss.REMARK,park.PARK_NAME,ss.CARRY_ITEM from SMT_SECURITYAREA_SUPPLIER ss left join SMT_PARK park on ss.PARK_ID=park.ID
AND ss.DEL_FLAG = 0
AND ss.PARK_ID=#{query.parkId}
AND ss.COMPANY_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{query.companyName}),'%')
AND (BEGIN_EFFECT_TIME < sysdate and END_EFFECT_TIME > sysdate)
AND (BEGIN_EFFECT_TIME > sysdate or END_EFFECT_TIME < sysdate)
and ss.PARK_ID in
#{item}
ORDER BY ss.CREATE_TIME desc

select SUPPLIER.ID,SUPPLIER.COMPANY_NAME,SUPPLIER.COMPANY_CODE,SUPPLIER.END_EFFECT_TIME,SUPPLIER.PROTOCOL_CODE, SUPPLIER.SUPPLIER_TYPE,SUPPLIER.PARK_ID,PARK.PARK_NAME,SUPPLIER.CARRY_ITEM, SUPPLIER.AUTHORIZED_AREA, SUPPLIER.AUTH_PERSON_NUM, SUPPLIER.CERT_NO, SUPPLIER.PERSON_NAME from SMT_SECURITYAREA_SUPPLIER SUPPLIER JOIN SMT_PARK PARK ON SUPPLIER.PARK_ID=PARK.ID
AND SUPPLIER.DEL_FLAG = 0
and SUPPLIER.PARK_ID=#{parkId}
AND SUPPLIER.COMPANY_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{compName}),'%')
and SUPPLIER.PARK_ID in
#{item}
order by SUPPLIER.CREATE_TIME desc
select * from SMT_SECURITYAREA_SUPPLIER where ID=#{id} and DEL_FLAG = 0 for update
